name: xaxi-app
description: XAXI - Ung dung quan ly thu chi ca nhan da nen tang

scripts.android:add: npm run build && cap add android && node scripts/patch-android-manifest.mjs && node scripts/sync-native.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android-manifest.mjs && node scripts/sync-native.mjs
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
